title: Maize Growing Tips for Sustainable Production 1
reason: Provides detailed instructions on how to grow maize more sustainably.

tasks.task: Describe the process of selecting and purchasing maize seeds.

subtasks.text: Consult with extension officers to choose the best maize variety for your area.
Purchase certified seeds from the AgroDealer recommended by the Agri Business Hubs.

tasks.task: Explain how to determine the appropriate planting time based on rainfall patterns.

subtasks.text: Plant late maturity varieties in regions with high rainfall during the early part of the rainy season.
Plant medium maturity varieties in the middle of the rainy season.
Plant early maturity varieties towards the end of the rainy season.

tasks.task: Discuss soil management practices for sustainable maize production.

subtasks.text: Ensure soil testing every 3 to 4 years for soil acidity and magnesium.
Apply lime to maintain a soil pH between 5.5 and 7 before planting.

tasks.task: Outline principles of maize planting and fertilization.

subtasks.text: Plan for 4 to 5 plants per square meter in areas with good rainfall and fertile soils.
Aim for 3 to 4 plants per square meter in areas with low rainfall or limited nutrients.
